summary: The test code contains a critical error where a Locator is treated as an array and iterated with a for loop, which is not supported by Playwright. This will cause runtime errors. Additionally, the assertion in TC-003 is weak and likely incorrect because it expects each product list item to contain the category name text, which is unlikely. Await is correctly used with assertions. Test case IDs are preserved. Selectors are reasonable but could be improved for robustness.

issues.description: The code incorrectly treats a Locator as an array and iterates over it with a for loop in TC-003. Playwright Locators do not support direct array iteration and must use Locator.nth() with await for each element.
issues.recommendation: Refactor the iteration to use a for loop with await productsLocator.nth(i) to get each Locator instance before assertions.

issues.description: The assertion in TC-003 expects each product list item to contain the category name text, which is unlikely to be true and may cause false failures.
issues.recommendation: Use a more reliable way to verify products belong to the category, such as checking product category labels or filtering products by category explicitly.

recommendations: Fix the Locator iteration in TC-003 to properly await each product Locator.
Improve the assertion logic in TC-003 to verify product category membership more reliably.
Consider parameterizing CATEGORY_NAME or verifying it exists before tests to avoid flaky failures.
